# Implementation Plan: Core Foundation Types & Memory

**Branch**: `003-core-types-memory` | **Date**: 2026-04-27 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)
**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/003-core-types-memory/spec.md`

**Note**: This plan was generated by the `/speckit.plan` command.

## Summary

Implement the first real Core layer feature: stable project-wide primitive types, string/name values, ownership pointer vocabulary, memory utilities, and container aliases. The design keeps the implementation inside `Source/Core`, uses the existing SCons static library skeleton, exposes individual public headers plus `CoreMinimal.h`, and adds Core-focused verification to the existing `Tests` executable.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: C++20 (traditional header/source separation; no C++20 Modules)  
**Primary Dependencies**: C++ standard library only; SCons 4.10.1 build system  
**Storage**: N/A (runtime primitives only; no persistent storage)  
**Testing**: Existing SCons-built `StonerTest` executable with self-contained Core verification code  
**Target Platform**: Windows (MSVC), macOS (Apple Clang/Clang), Linux (GCC/Clang)  
**Project Type**: Static library feature in the engine Core layer  
**Performance Goals**: Type/container aliases add no project-specific runtime overhead; `FName` equality short-circuits by hash before text comparison; aligned allocation returns addresses satisfying requested valid alignments  
**Constraints**: Core must not include RHI, Backend, Renderer, or Application; no graphics API dependencies; public names must follow UE5-style prefixes; behavior must be deterministic for edge cases  
**Scale/Scope**: 7 primitive categories (`FPlatformTypes`, `FString`, `FName`, `TSharedPtr`, `TUniquePtr`, `FMemory`, `TArray`, `TMap`) plus verification coverage for normal, boundary, and invalid-input cases

**Structure Decision**: Use the existing Core static library layout from Phase 001. Public API lives under `Source/Core/Public/Core/` so downstream code includes `Core/<Header>.h`. Implementation that requires emitted symbols lives under `Source/Core/Private/`. Verification is added to the existing `Tests` executable rather than creating a new test framework or binary.

## Phase 0 Research Summary

Research decisions are recorded in [research.md](./research.md):

- Use standard-library-backed initial primitives to keep the first Core phase small and stable.
- Make `FName` immutable with stored text plus hash, using hash as a fast path and text comparison for collision correctness.
- Implement aligned memory through C++ aligned allocation facilities with deterministic invalid-input behavior.
- Keep `TSharedPtr`, `TUniquePtr`, `TArray`, and `TMap` as project-named aliases for this phase.
- Use a self-contained test harness inside `StonerTest` instead of adding an external dependency.
